items.why: Does로 묻는 문장에서는 has가 have(원형)로 바뀌어요.

items.q:
A: Do you have a pet?
B: No, I ___.
items.why: Do로 묻는 질문에는 Do를 써서 대답해요. 부정은 don't예요.

items.q:
A: Does Jun like soccer?
B: Yes, he ___.
items.why: Does로 묻는 질문에는 Yes, he does.로 대답해요.

items.q:
A: Did you see the movie?
B: No, I ___.
items.why: Did로 묻는 질문에는 didn't로 부정해서 대답해요.

items.q:
A: Will it rain tomorrow?
B: No, it ___.
items.why: Will로 묻는 질문에는 will을 써서 No, it won't.로 대답해요.

items.q:
A: Are you hungry?
B: No, I ___.
items.why: Are you ...?에는 I am not으로 대답해요. I aren't는 틀려요.

items.q: Which question asks about the PAST?
items.why: Did로 시작하면 지난 일을 묻는 질문이에요.

items.q: Which question asks about the FUTURE?
items.why: Will로 시작하면 앞으로의 일을 묻는 질문이에요.

items.q: doesn't 뒤에는 어떤 모양의 동사가 올까요?
items.why: doesn't 뒤에는 항상 동사원형을 써요.

items.q: Which is a wh-question?
o: What do you want for lunch?
items.why: What, Where, Who 같은 의문사로 시작하는 질문을 wh-question이라고 해요.

items.q: Which question word asks about a PLACE?
items.why: Where는 장소를 물을 때 써요.

items.q: Which question word asks about a PERSON?
items.why: Who는 사람을 물을 때 써요.

items.q: Which question word asks for a REASON?
items.why: Why는 이유를 물을 때 써요.

items.q: Which question word asks about a NUMBER of things?
items.why: How many는 셀 수 있는 것의 수를 물을 때 써요.

items.q: Which is a good answer to 'What time do you wake up?'
items.why: What time은 시각을 묻는 말이에요.

items.q: Which is a good answer to 'Where does Hana study?'
items.why: Where는 장소를 묻는 말이라서 장소로 대답해요.

items.q: Which is a good answer to 'Why were you late?'
items.why: Why로 물으면 Because로 이유를 대답해요.

items.q: Which is a good answer to 'Is your bag heavy?'
items.why: Is로 묻는 질문에는 is로 대답해요.

items.q: Which is a good answer to 'Does your dog bark at night?'
items.why: Does로 묻고 주어가 your dog(it)이므로 doesn't로 대답해요.

items.q: Which is a good answer to 'Do they play chess?'
items.why: Do they ...?에는 Yes, they do.로 대답해요.

items.q: 다음 중 부정문은?
items.why: doesn't가 있는 문장은 부정문이에요.

items.q: Which sentence needs a question mark (?)
items.why: Where로 시작해서 묻는 문장 끝에는 물음표(?)를 써요.

items.q: 'will not'의 줄임말은 무엇일까요?
items.why: will not은 won't로 줄여 써요.

items.q: 'does not'의 줄임말을 바르게 쓴 것은?
items.why: does not은 doesn't로 줄이고, 어퍼스트로피는 n과 t 사이에 써요.

items.title: A New Pet
items.text: Sam wants a dog, but his mother is not sure. "Do you know how to take care of a dog?" she asks. Sam says, "Yes, I do. I will feed it and walk it every day." His mother smiles. She doesn't want a big dog because their house is small, so they will visit a pet shop on Sunday.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: Sam asks for a pet dog.
qs.why: 샘이 개를 키우고 싶어 하고 엄마와 이야기하는 내용이에요.

qs.q: What does Sam promise to do?
o: Feed the dog and walk it
qs.why: I will feed it and walk it every day라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why doesn't his mother want a big dog?
qs.why: because their house is small이라고 했어요.

qs.q: When will they visit the pet shop?
qs.why: they will visit a pet shop on Sunday라고 했어요.

qs.q: How does his mother seem at the end?
qs.why: His mother smiles 라고 해서 샘의 대답에 만족한 것을 알 수 있어요.

items.title: The Umbrella
items.text: Yuna waits at the bus stop. It is raining, but she doesn't have an umbrella. An old man asks, "Are you cold?" "A little," says Yuna. He gives her his umbrella. "Don't you need it?" she asks. "No, my house is near," he says. Yuna says thank you and smiles.

qs.q: What problem does Yuna have?
o: She is lost in the city.
She has no umbrella in the rain.
qs.why: It is raining, but she doesn't have an umbrella라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does the old man ask Yuna?
qs.why: An old man asks, "Are you cold?"라고 했어요.

qs.q: In "Don't you need it?", what does 'it' mean?
qs.why: it은 바로 앞에서 노인이 준 우산을 가리켜요.

qs.q: Why doesn't the old man need the umbrella?
qs.why: No, my house is near라고 했어요.

qs.q: What kind of person is the old man?
qs.why: 추운 낯선 아이에게 우산을 주었으니 친절한 사람이에요.

items.title: Lunch Survey
items.text: Mina asked her classmates about lunch. Does everyone like fish? Eight students said no. Do they like chicken? Fourteen students said yes. Most students don't like vegetables, but they love ice cream. Mina will tell the cooks the results on Monday.

qs.q: Why did Mina ask her classmates questions?
o: To learn what they like to eat
qs.why: 점심 메뉴에 대한 친구들의 취향을 조사했어요.

qs.q: How many students said yes to chicken?
qs.why: Do they like chicken? Fourteen students said yes라고 했어요.

qs.q: What do most students NOT like?
qs.why: Most students don't like vegetables라고 했어요.

qs.q: Who will hear the results on Monday?
qs.why: Mina will tell the cooks the results on Monday라고 했어요.

qs.q: Which sentence is true?
o: Mina will tell the results today.
qs.why: Eight students said no to fish라고 했어요.

items.title: Bolt the Robot
items.text: Zoe's school has a robot named Bolt. Bolt doesn't eat or sleep. It helps students find books in the library. Does Bolt talk? Yes, it does, but it speaks very softly. Last week, Bolt didn't work for one day, so the students looked for books by themselves.

qs.q: What does Bolt do at school?
qs.why: It helps students find books in the library라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does 'softly' mean in the passage?
qs.why: speaks very softly는 아주 작게(조용히) 말한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Which sentence about Bolt is true?
qs.why: Bolt doesn't eat or sleep라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why did students look for books by themselves last week?
o: Bolt did not work that day.
qs.why: Bolt didn't work for one day라고 했어요.

items.ex: Raise your hand and ask a question.
